summary: Told multi-domain rubric with SINGLE ITEM per domain is valid and reliable because it is approved by CAEP. That isn't how reliabiltiy and validity work. ...I have no idea how you do content validity on a multiple domain assessment with only one item per domain.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Told multi-domain rubric with SINGLE ITEM per domain is valid and reliable because it is approved by CAEP. That isn't how reliabiltiy and validity work. ...I have no idea how you do content validity on a multiple domain assessment with only one item per domain.
